site.rename_hint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, 3–40 characters. The old address stops working.

admin.title: Access
admin.lead: People on this list can publish sites. Add an email, or a whole domain like @zerde.ai.
error.code_invalid: This code is wrong or has expired.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {wait}.
error.google_failed: Couldn't sign in with Google. Try again or use email.
error.signed_out: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
error.forbidden: You don't have access to this page
error.name_invalid: Use 3–40 lowercase Latin letters, digits or hyphens.
error.pattern_invalid: Enter an email or a domain that starts with @.
upload.error.too_big: The upload is larger than {mb} MB.
upload.error.no_index: There is no index.html at the top level.
upload.error.duplicate_path: Two files have the same path: {path}
upload.error.site_gone: The site's address changed or the site was deleted during the upload. Nothing was published.
upload.error.server_error: The server couldn't save the upload. Try again later.
js.failed: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
login.pitch: Drop a folder. Get a link.
login.lead_short: Use Google or a one-time code sent to your email.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.store_google: If you sign in with Google: your Google account ID, name and profile picture URL.
privacy.store_files: The files you upload, and when and by whom each version was published.
privacy.store_ip: Your IP address, to limit sign-in code requests and in server logs.
privacy.store_cookies: Cookies: a session cookie that keeps you signed in, a language cookie, and short-lived cookies for the sign-in steps and one-time messages.
privacy.why: To sign you in, decide who may publish, show you your sites and their history, and serve the sites you publish.
privacy.never: No ads. We don't sell or share your data. There are no third-party analytics or trackers. Google is used only to verify your sign-in.
privacy.public: Anything you publish is visible to anyone who has the link.
privacy.delete: You can delete your sites at any time on the site page. Deleted sites and their files are removed from the server. To delete your account data, write to the administrator.
